description: Check an MCP server.json file before you publish it to the official MCP Registry. Send the file text (up to 20,000 characters). Get back valid or invalid the way the registry's own validator decides it: every JSON Schema error against the official registry schema 2025-12-11 with its JSON Pointer path, and the registry's semantic checks: name in reverse-DNS namespace/name form, a specific version (not 'latest' or a range), repository URL for its source, https website and icon URLs, package identifiers and versions, package and remote transports (stdio without a url, https remotes that are not localhost, every {variable} in a URL defined), named arguments, the $schema line and the 4 KB publisher metadata limit. Warnings name fields the registry ignores, drops or reads under another spelling. Also the server name, version, package registry types and remote transport types it read. Nothing is fetched. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/mcp-server-json-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

server_json.description: The server.json file text (JSON), up to 20,000 characters. Send the text, not a link: nothing is fetched.
